title: MeECL Casual Employees Protest Outsourcing Order, Demand Withdrawal Before 1st December

ai.summary: More than 160 casual employees of Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited staged a protest demanding withdrawal of an October 23 order that places them under a manpower agency from December 1, fearing reduced wages and benefits.

facts.claim: More than 160 casual employees of the Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited staged a protest at the corporation's headquarters in Lumjingshai, Meghalaya, on 24th November
facts.quote: More than 160 casual employees of the Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited (MeECL) staged a protest at the corporation's headquarters in Lumjingshai, Meghalaya, on 24th November

facts.claim: demanding the withdrawal of an 23rd October order that places them under a manpower agency from 1st December
facts.quote: demanding the withdrawal of an 23rd October order that places them under a manpower agency from 1st December

facts.claim: The protesting employees are opposing a management decision requiring casual workers engaged under 30-day and 89-day arrangements to work through a manpower agency
facts.quote: The protesting employees are opposing a management decision requiring casual workers engaged under 30-day and 89-day arrangements to work through a manpower agency

facts.claim: The order, issued on 23rd October, is scheduled to take effect on December 1
facts.quote: The order, issued on 23rd October, is scheduled to take effect on December 1

facts.claim: Workers have demanded that the corporation withdraw the directive before its implementation
facts.quote: Workers have demanded that the corporation withdraw the directive before its implementation

facts.claim: Employees fear that moving their employment arrangements under an outside agency could affect their existing working conditions, particularly their wages and service-related benefits
facts.quote: Employees fear that moving their employment arrangements under an outside agency could affect their existing working conditions, particularly their wages and service-related benefits

facts.claim: The employees have appealed to Power Minister Timothy D. Shira and Chief Minister Conrad K. Sangma to intervene in the matter
facts.quote: The employees have appealed to Power Minister Timothy D. Shira and Chief Minister Conrad K. Sangma to intervene in the matter

facts.claim: More than 160 casual employees participated in the November 24 protest
facts.quote: More than 160 casual employees participated in the November 24 protest

facts.claim: Among those affected are around 28 Garo youths
facts.quote: Among those affected are around 28 Garo youths

facts.claim: The employees are engaged under different short-term contractual arrangements, including 89-day and 39-day contracts
facts.quote: The employees are engaged under different short-term contractual arrangements, including 89-day and 39-day contracts

facts.claim: Workers are concerned that the change could affect their existing service conditions and financial security
facts.quote: Workers are concerned that the change could affect their existing service conditions and financial security

ai.background_note: Meghalaya Energy Corporation Limited employees are protesting against a management decision to place them under a manpower agency from December 1, which they fear will reduce wages and benefits.
